Wordbearer.name: Rightful Owner
Wordbearer.description: Increase impact when defending your deliveries, and when attempting to retrieve something stolen from yourself or your crew.

Wordbearer.name: Oathbound
Wordbearer.description: You're immune to chemical, arconautic, and mesmeric effects designed to draw information from you.

Wordbearer.name: Weatherbeaten
Wordbearer.description: You're resistant to three damage types, chosen from the following list: Blast, Acid, Toxin, Frost, Flame.

Wordbearer.name: Promise-Twine
Wordbearer.description: When a resource you're trying to deliver would be destroyed or lost it degrades instead, gaining a negative tag (if it already has a negative tag, it is consumed as normal).

Wordbearer.name: Courier's Cage
Wordbearer.description: Consume a specimen to call a nearby messenger creature to you safely, and retrieve both the creature and whatever message they're holding as resources

Wordbearer.name: Glyph Flares
Wordbearer.description: A set of chemical fireworks that burst in bright, recognisable glyph shapes.

Wordbearer.name: Pattern-Reader
Wordbearer.description: A miniature gramophone for playing scribed cylinders of wax, ceramics, or cured bark. Mark to record a fragment of conversation or sound you can hear, to be played back at a later time.

Wordbearer.name: Undeliverables
Wordbearer.description: Sometimes the oath is broken by the death of a receiver. You carry those undelivered letters and parcels around as a memorial, or possibly a penance.

Wordbearer.name: Canvas Sling
Wordbearer.description: A simple but effective weapon. Deals LR Blunt damage, and increases impact on CQ actions made to trip or restrain a target

Wordbearer.name: Sortomaton
Wordbearer.description: A wheezing machine used for the sorting and categorizing of mail. You count as fluent in all languages, but only when reading addresses, listening to directions, or commiting a sender's message to memory.

Wordbearer.name: Retired Courier Dragonfly
Wordbearer.description: Still swift, but lacking stamina. Mark to gain a resource from your surroundings with some kind of text as a component, such as a chart or painted sign.

Wordbearer.name: Dead Letters
Wordbearer.description: Consume a resource to 'deliver it' to the Under-Eaves by throwing it over the side of a ship. Gain a whisper based on the delivery, with the Echoing tag

Wordbearer.name: Crawling Jar
Wordbearer.description: Mark to add a resource to the crawling jar. This resource is impossible to find for any individual other than you, as to them the jar will appear empty. The crawling jar can hold any number of resources. Burn to pull a random resource from the jar that you never put in there (determined by the Firefly).

Mesmer.name: Autohypnosis
Mesmer.description: You've learned to meditate rather than sleep, allowing you to stay far more aware while resting than most.

Mesmer.name: Meditative Healing
Mesmer.description: Using a task to meditate in a peaceful environment allows you to heal each of your damaged traits or each of your injury tracks by one.

Mesmer.name: An Uncomfortable Understanding
Mesmer.description: Burn to clear one of a crewmate's mire tracks entirely.

Mesmer.name: Empty the Mind
Mesmer.description: Ignore cut from pain, hallucination and distractions while trying to act.

Mesmer.name: Knowing The Unknown
Mesmer.description: Mark to identify a target's secret fear, or burn to accurately evaluate the truth of a statement.

Mesmer.name: Parasite Thought
Mesmer.description: A living thought that's taken root in your mind, invisible but able to interact with the world. Allows you to hold and manipulate more objects than usual.

Mesmer.name: Intricate Tattoos
Mesmer.description: You're immune to confusion and hallucinations that you don't invite or create yourself.

Mesmer.name: Staredown
Mesmer.description: Locking eyes with an opponent allows you to assail their mind with unwanted sensation, manifesting as LR Salt damage. Only works on creatures with sight.

Mesmer.name: Chameleon Veil
Mesmer.description: Use a task to hold still and blend in with your surroundings, becoming almost impossible to notice until you move again.

Mesmer.name: Shard of Dream-Soaked Amber
Mesmer.description: Consume a specimen to experience a thought or memory from a nearby individual.

Mesmer.name: Seven-Eye Scrawl
Mesmer.description: Eyes are daubed across your body, each of them able to perceive the world in a different way. Mark to gain a specialized form of sight for a brief time (such as the ability to see ghosts, heat, or magnetism).

Mesmer.name: Smoked-Glass Hookah
Mesmer.description: Releases a steady stream of wispy smoke. Mark to control smoke or vapours.

Mesmer.name: Chromiguana
Mesmer.description: Slow-moving and sleepy, usually found curled up around your shoulders or at the bottom of a bag. A surprisingly relaxing presence - treat conflicts as triumphs when trying to calm yourself or others.

Mesmer.name: Pinned Butterfly
Mesmer.description: Mark to wake the butterfly for a brief time. While awake, the hypnotic patterns of the butterfly's wings induce drowsiness in those that catch sight of them.

Mesmer.name: Amberglass Spectacles
Mesmer.description: Treat conflicts as triumphs when investigating mysteries or discerning truths while at least one watchful eye is marked or burned. If both watchful eyes are marked or burned, increase impact on therse actions as well.

Mesmer.name: Guilewasps
Mesmer.description: Spectral, flickering, barely there at all. When one of your crewmates uses a whisper, mark to gain a twisted copy of that whisper as a resource (supplied by the Firefly).

Agronaut.name: Dawn to Dusk to Dawn
Agronaut.description: Immediately mark the first box on the Grow track of anything you plant under sunlight or moonlight (choose one when you take this trait).

Agronaut.name: Constant Gardener
Agronaut.description: When a plot would be damaged or destroyed (or otherwise negatively affected by the environment), burn to avoid this effect.

Agronaut.name: Perfectly Ripe
Agronaut.description: Crewmates treat disasters as conflicts when using specimens you've grown as part of a creation.

Agronaut.name: Soothing Harvester
Agronaut.description: Plants grown aboard your ship (or body) are immune to blight and sickness. Mark to improve the rarity of any plant-based specimen you acquire from plots.

Agronaut.name: Delicate Step
Agronaut.description: You disturb no leaves and leave no footprints. You gain resistance to the hazardous effects of crezzerin, and increase impact on actions taken to move through densely forested areas.

Agronaut.name: Green Mile
Agronaut.description: Once per journey, replace the results of a watch roll with the Peace outcome. If you finish a journey without using this option, remove a negative tag from any one plant growing on your ship.

Agronaut.name: Paradox Slug-Box
Agronaut.description: These slugs exude crezzer-neutralizing slime and resist all forms of alchemical experimentation. All plots you own are resistant to crezzerin-based damage or effects. Use a task to create a resource, Paradox Slime.

Agronaut.name: Sumptuous Seed-Bag
Agronaut.description: For a combination of hard graft and showing off. Use a task to create a seed-based specimen based on any plant currently growing within a plot (on your ship or person).

Agronaut.name: Misting Coppercan
Agronaut.description: You are almost impossible to detect for predatory plants of all kinds. In addition, whenever you would gain a plant specimen with a negative tag, you may mark mire to remove that tag entirely.

Agronaut.name: Vespin Almanac
Agronaut.description: Filled with scrawlings on wildfruit theories and hazardous farming techniques. Consume a whisper to add a positive tag to a growing plant, or voluntarily clear three boxes on a Grow track to gain a related whisper.

Agronaut.name: Portable Plot
Agronaut.description: You just have too many ideas for one deck to handle. You gain an extra plot, always attached to you, with 4/4 spaces for growing plants. You must add a growing medium to this plot for it to be effective.

Agronaut.name: Brute-Shovel
Agronaut.description: Deals CQ Hewing damage, and allows you to treat conflicts as triumphs when gathering plant-based specimens.

Agronaut.name: Ireful Pitchfork
Agronaut.description: Deals CQ Spike damage, and increases impact on actions taken to defend against or fend off hazards that would threaten the integrity of ship-borne plants.

Agronaut.name: Sabre-Nosed Bat
Agronaut.description: A voracious leather-winged protector, eager to defend your growing-plots. Deals LR Keen damage, and all plots you own are resistant to insect-based damage or effects.

Agronaut.name: Amblecotta Pot
Agronaut.description: A tottering, stylized pot filled with simple soil. You gain an extra plot, always nearby to you, with 4/4 spaces for growing plants. This companion counts as a full solution, both plot and medium combined.

Agronaut.name: Harvester
Agronaut.description: Plants grown aboard your ship (or body) are immune to blight and sickness. Mark to improve the rarity of any plant-based specimen you acquire from plots.

Broadcaster.name: The Good Times, The Bad Times
Broadcaster.description: The key to a long life is to learn from mistakes - even if they're not yours. Once per scene, whenever you or a crewmate takes a mark of mire, either gain a whisper (supplied by the Firefly) or clear a mark from this aspect.

Broadcaster.name: Tree-Shanty Troubador
Broadcaster.description: Nothing's more invigorating than a classic, one that everyone knows the words to. Once per journey, when you drop anchor to take a montage, all crew can take an additional task.

Broadcaster.name: Hectastep Shuffle
Broadcaster.description: A pre-Verdant art, somewhere between dance and defence. Ignore cut that would be applied for difficulty when defending against or reacting to CQ attacks.

Broadcaster.name: The Beat Kicks In
Broadcaster.description: Any instrument you wield as a weapon (whether an aspect or a resource) can deal CQ Blast damage in addition to any other damage types. In addition, attacks you make that deal Blast damage can always hit multiple nearby targets.

Broadcaster.name: Wideband Resonator
Broadcaster.description: You can throw your voice, making it seem to issue from any nearby object capable of resonation (such as an instrument, a glass jar, or a hollow tree stump).

Broadcaster.name: Cool, Calm, And Collected
Broadcaster.description: Whenever you mark mire, gain a whisper with wording related to the source of that mire (supplied by the Firefly). You may elect to mark mire in place of a nearby ally once per scene.

Broadcaster.name: Vox Amplifier
Broadcaster.description: A new take on the hunting horn, perhaps? When you shout a whisper into existence, make a 1d6 Fortune Roll. On a 6 you immediately gain a copy of that whisper as a new resource.

Broadcaster.name: Decanter of Vinylbrandy
Broadcaster.description: An arconautic draught that affects the vocal chords. When you gain this aspect, choose two of the benefits below. Mark to gain one of the chosen benefits until end of scene. Your voice becomes soft but powerful, dangerously melodic. Increase impact when singing, and when calming or persuading others. Your voice rises to a booming roar. You can deal LR Blast damage, but only against targets capable of hearing sound. Your voice turns to radio static, unnerving and oddly distant. Treat disasters as conflicts when trying to intimidate or disconcert. Your voice is choked down to almost nothing, leaving you barely able to speak, but at the end of the scene create and gain a whisper based on what you might have wanted to say.

Broadcaster.name: Radio Speculator
Broadcaster.description: A portable device that's small enough to fit into a rucksack. Use a task to identify and tune into any radio signals in the area, and to learn roughly where they originate from.

Broadcaster.name: The Fever
Broadcaster.description: A looping whisper stolen from a particularly catchy song is trapped in your head, refusing to be spoken. You are immune to compulsions and mesmeric effects, and automatically learn a secret or truth about any new song that you hear (supplied by the Firefly).

Broadcaster.name: Phonograph Construct
Broadcaster.description: A complex punch-card driven automaton carrying a set of wax en cylinders. Can reco rd short periods of audio when commanded to, which can be stored and played back at a later time.

Spielographer.name: Taming the Word
Spielographer.description: You are immune to arconautic compulsion and confusion from written or spoken words, and resist any damage or effects that would be caused by whispers being released into the world.

Spielographer.name: Inspiration
Spielographer.description: If a crewmate has worked towards satisfying a drive (or earned a milestone), you gain increased impact on actions or tasks taken to work on a personal project until the end of the next scene.

Spielographer.name: Rewrite the Ending
Spielographer.description: Whenever a crewmate would mark the final box on one of their tracks, you may consume a whisper. If you do so, that box remains unmarked and you hijack focus.

Spielographer.name: Writer's Repose
Spielographer.description: Whenever you add a box to a literary project of some kind, or gain a literature-based resource (such as a book or chart), clear a mark of damage from one of your traits.

Spielographer.name: We Both Know How This Ends
Spielographer.description: Burn to allow a crewmember of your choice to ignore cut while attacking and defending against a hazard you've encountered before (for the duration of a scene).

Spielographer.name: Type-Hammer Ordinator
Spielographer.description: A clunky machine used for printing script on paper, that jams as often as it works. Deals CQ Blunt damage, and can be marked to remove a negative tag from a chart.

Spielographer.name: Rose Codex
Spielographer.description: A beautiful stone, scribed in multiple languages. Use a task to study the codex, gaining a temporary rank in two languages of your choice until you use this aspect again. If you mark the codex during this task, your crewmates also gain a temporary rank in one of those languages for the same duration.

Spielographer.name: Scrap-Paper Notebook
Spielographer.description: Whenever you would use a task, you also gain the resource Hastily Scrawled Notes.

Spielographer.name: Quillhound
Spielographer.description: A distant cousin of the pinwolf that deals CQ Spike damage. You can use a task to gain a resource, either Hound's Ink, Hound's Quill, or Hound's Binding.

Spielographer.name: The Masterpiece
Spielographer.description: This is more than a journal, more than a book... This is a living history of yourself, your ship, and your crewmates. When you choose the Masterpiece as an aspect, it gains two benefits of your choice from the following list... Notes in the Margin : You can read (but not speak) all scripts of the rustling waves, as if you had a smattering of every language. Remember That One : When you take this trait choose either beasts, plants, insects, constructs, or marauders. You're immune to damage (but not any associated effects) from the first attack made by your chosen source in any given scene. The Spiel : You know your stories. Treat conflicts as triumphs when convincing or befriending an individual by telling a tale of events you were involved in. Adding Detail to the Tome : Any time a crewmate gains a whisper, mark the Masterpiece to gain a chart related to that whisper.

Augmentor.name: Chimeric Reveal
Augmentor.description: Choose three traits from bloodlines other than your own to hold as reveals . During play you may consume a specimen to instantly manifest the benefits of one of these reveals (tying their special ability and any narrative benefits to this trait). These benefits only last until end of scene, but you can gain access to multiple reveals at the same time by consuming a specimen for each

Augmentor.name: Recombinant
Augmentor.description: Your form is more deliberate than most could conceive of. When you take a trait from any bloodline other than your own, add two boxes to the trait's usual track length.

Augmentor.name: Advanced Adaptation
Augmentor.description: Pain is the first step to immunity. Mark to gain resistance to a damage type of your choice until end of scene, or burn to gain immunity until end of scene instead.

Augmentor.name: The Beast Within
Augmentor.description: Mark mire to grow a natural weapon, which can deal CQ damage of any one type until end of scene. You may mark mire twice to hijack focus at the same time.

Augmentor.name: This Looks Interesting
Augmentor.description: The most difficult question: to catalogue, or to incorporate? When you gain a specimen, you may either add the Preserved tag, or add a negative tag and clear a mark of damage on any one of your traits instead.

Augmentor.name: All Life Speaks
Augmentor.description: Living, dead, or in pieces, you can hear them. Consume two specimens, or a single specimen with the Preserved tag, and treat it as if you just used a whisper based on what was consumed.

Augmentor.name: One With All
Augmentor.description: When you touch a living thing, mark to gain a 2-track temporary trait based on that creature. You can only have one of these temporary traits at a time.

Augmentor.name: Irregular Elixir
Augmentor.description: The search for perfection is a fool's errand. Consuming a specimen and marking mire allows you or a nearby ally to gain a temporary two-track trait from the list below. Mutagenic Weapon : Whenever you roll doubles while making a CQ attack, gain the effects of both a combat-based critical and the usual twist. Wild Form : Choose Stealth, Vault, or Wavewalk. You count as having three ranks in this skill. Splitting the Iris : Gain the ability to see heat, detect electrical fields, or gain vision covering 360 degrees. Coarse Covering : Through emerging plates, thick fur, or new-grown spines, this temporary trait gains four boxes rather than the usual two. Rampancy : You grow a natural weapon that deals CQ Keen damage. You may mark mire to increase your impact when dealing CQ damage

Augmentor.name: Scrawled Research Notes
Augmentor.description: After a lifetime devoted to a singular topic, your work is nearly complete. Treat conflicts as triumphs when studying (or conversing on the topic of) beasts.

Augmentor.name: Earworm Network
Augmentor.description: Don't ask how it's done. You, and all members of your crew, can communicate at great distances. This communication is silent to those outside the network.

Augmentor.name: Chromaquill
Augmentor.description: A hedgehog with transparent quills. Each easily-shed quill is filled with coloured ink, giving the Chromaquill a rainbow appearance. Use a task to create two specimens, Coloured Ink and Hollow Quill .

Augmentor.name: Bluering Pallas
Augmentor.description: A white cat with blue rings on its fur, eight legs, two tails, and barbed suction cups on its paws, perfectly adapted to life on the waves. Deals CQ Toxin damage

Open Aeronautic Aspects.name: Mayfly Reflex
Open Aeronautic Aspects.description: Once per scene, when targeted by an attack or effect while aloft (which covers anything from leaping at a great height to flying), burn to hijack focus and avoid the incoming danger completely.

Open Aeronautic Aspects.name: Rigid Kite
Open Aeronautic Aspects.description: A less complex version of the kitesailor's unique apparatus, constructed from painted fabrics and an inflexible frame. Mark to gain the Rush and Glide styles until end of scene.

Open Aeronautic Aspects.name: Cloudwire
Open Aeronautic Aspects.description: Alchemically treated filaments that seek out clouds, pulling their user along for the ride. Mark to unspool your cloudwire, gaining the Float, Hover, and Soar styles until end of scene, but these are only usable when you have a sightline to the clouds.

Open Aeronautic Aspects.name: Spiralgull
Open Aeronautic Aspects.description: A rare bird with twisting patterns running across its feathers, known for leading aeronauts out of trouble and into safer skies. Treat conflicts as triumphs when performing aerial stunts.

Open Submeric Aspects.name: Hazard Burst-Grapples
Open Submeric Aspects.description: Once per scene, when targeted by an attack or effect while delving that might cause you to fall, burn to hijack focus and release the burst-grapples, yanking you to a nearby point of interest and out of harm's way.

Open Submeric Aspects.name: Undersuit
Open Submeric Aspects.description: A less complex version of the diver's pressure suit, constructed from leaf rubber, salvaged metals, and a large drum of clean air. Mark to become immune to the effects of bad air and drifting spores at depth for the duration of a scene.

Open Submeric Aspects.name: Brass Arborofathometer
Open Submeric Aspects.description: Once per scene while delving, you may check the Firefly's Pressure Gauge (learning the current Pressure Level, length of track, and how many marks it has).

Open Submeric Aspects.name: Jag-Spinner
Open Submeric Aspects.description: A noisy chainsaw-like tool used for cutting through thick branches at depths. Deals CQ Spike damage, or mark to have it deal CQ Hewing or Serrated damage for the duration of a scene.

Open Submeric Aspects.name: Malusan Eel
Open Submeric Aspects.description: Toothy and loathsome to all but their owners and the ships they call home. Treat conflicts as triumphs when moving across the outside of a vessel under Pressure

Itzenko.name: Iterative Moult
Itzenko.description: Your outer chitin is part protection, part self-expression, part project, and part ambition. Use a task to moult, gaining two benefits of your choice from the following list that last until you moult with this aspect again... Recurve Claw : Sometimes the old ways are the best. You deal CQ Keen or Hewing damage. Spined Scissor : You deal CQ Spike damage, and treat conflicts as triumphs when restraining a target. Fluting : You are immune to Keen damage. Bulwark Shell : You resist Blunt and Blast damage. Tetrantid : You've sculpted yourself additional limbs, allowing you to hold more than is usually possible. Refine : Add one temporary rank to any two of your existing skills. Reconstruct : Add one temporary box to any two of your aspects (temporary boxes are lost when burned or marked)

Itzenko.name: Shaping the Self
Itzenko.description: You treat all chitin-based resources as if they had the Medicinal tag. In addition, any time you heal damage on an aspect using a chitin-based resource, add a temporary box to that aspect's track (this temporary box is lost when it would be marked or burned).

Itzenko.name: Bursting Moult
Itzenko.description: Mark to hijack focus and tear free of your outer shell, leaving a chitinous husk in your wake. Until the end of the scene you're weak to all incoming damage, but increase impact on all movement-based actions.

Itzenko.name: Modes of Prayer
Itzenko.description: A fighting style that comes naturally to those of mantid descent, all portentous stillness and burst of swift movement. You deal CQ Keen damage, and when you would cut for precision, cut one fewer result than usual.

Itzenko.name: Ambitious Mimic
Itzenko.description: Consume a whisper to mimic a trait or piece of gear belonging to a crewmate, gaining a copy of it as a temporary trait. You can only have one such temporary trait at a time.

Itzenko.name: True Dedication
Itzenko.description: It's not a grind, it's a process. When you drop anchor or reach port, mark the track of any one project you're working on (once per journey).

Itzenko.name: Translucent Wings
Itzenko.description: A rare achievement within an ambitious society that allows you near-perfect flight, albeit for short periods. Mark to gain the Float, Hover, and Soar styles for the duration of a scene.

Itzenko.name: Sculptor's Claw-Hammer
Itzenko.description: Ritual shaping-tools for working on your own chitin. Mark to gain a specimen from the following list, either Chitin Fragment , Living Shard, or Dripping Ichor .

Itzenko.name: Intercut Fabrics
Itzenko.description: Designed to be worn above, around, and even below your changing chitinous exoskeleton. You resist the harmful effects of crezzerin, and are immune to drifting spores.

Itzenko.name: Copper-Chi Simulacra
Itzenko.description: Sculpting metal isn't as easy as sculpting chitin, but sometimes a trial run is needed before you commit to an idea. Salvage can be used to heal your traits and injuries, and for you also counts as a chitin-based resource.

Itzenko.name: Moult-Husk Marionette
Itzenko.description: Most shed chitin dissolves or scatters after a moult, but this set was tenacious. When you gain this aspect, select a gang choice from the undercrew section. The Moult- Husk Marionette mimics their ability during journeys.

Kosmer.name: Eyrie Swing
Kosmer.description: You move with an uncannily light step, no matter how laden down you are. Your presence never seems to add weight to surfaces.

Kosmer.name: Mask Under Mask
Kosmer.description: Your face, even when unmasked, is immobile - you can hide emotions and feelings with ease, even under the most intense pressure.

Kosmer.name: Wide-Arms Ritual
Kosmer.description: Use a task and mark mire to allow every member of the crew to consume a specimen if they wish - those that do can either clear a mark of their own mire, take an additional task, or clear a mark of damage on one of their trait or companion aspects.

Kosmer.name: As Above, So Below
Kosmer.description: When you take this trait, choose either 'Above' or 'Below'. When the watchful eye related to your choice is marked or burned, treat conflicts as triumphs when engaging with the danger it represents in any way.

Kosmer.name: Obscuring Words
Kosmer.description: Consume a whisper to allow any nearby individuals you choose to communicate freely in Low Sour without being understood by any other individuals until end of scene.

Kosmer.name: Baffler Ribbons
Kosmer.description: When you make a roll that's cut for Scrutiny, you treat cut results of 3, 2, or 1 as 4.

Kosmer.name: Lightning Lash
Kosmer.description: Deals LR Blunt or Volt damage, and increases impact on attempts to restrain or tangle a target. If a target affected by the lash tries to escape, hijack focus (once per scene).

Kosmer.name: Cyclopean Mantle
Kosmer.description: The single eye set into this mantle is traditionally taken from a hunting beast of the wild blue. Mark to see through a usually opaque surface (such as a wall or a cloudbank) with perfect clarity for a short time.

Kosmer.name: Kosmeri Mask
Kosmer.description: Though some kosmer choose a simple and unstylized second face, many strive for a blend of uniqueness and usefulness. This gear option allows you to choose up to four benefits from the list below, each benefit reducing the aspect's track by one box . You can choose from... Dominant Nose : Gain increased impact when gaining information or tracking through scent. Additional Eyes : You can see in all directions at once, and can burn to hijack focus when ambushed. Uncovered Eye : A challenge to the heavens. Whenever the watchful eye from above is marked or burned, you are immune to mire. Teeth or Tusks : You can deal CQ Spike or Hewing damage (choose one when you take this benefit). Sea of Tongues : You can speak the same words in multiple known languages simultaneously. Lacquered Mane : Waves of reinforced hair that grant resistance against Keen and Hewing damage. Shining Visage : The mask is inlaid with gold and precious stones. Mark to gain a resource, Gold Scrapings or Unsocketed Gem . Starlight Sconce : A fragment of glowing metal that sits like a crown. Your mask acts as a strong light source that you can only dim by covering it.

Kosmer.name: Cloak of Stolen Stars
Kosmer.description: You master what hungers for you, removing one of many threats from the world. You are immune to all effects of the Hungry Stars watcher, and gain the Rush and Soar styles in any area starlight touches.

Kosmer.name: Counterweight Ferret
Kosmer.description: Scampers from place to place on your body to aid uncertain movements. You are immune to vertigo, and treat disasters as conflicts when trying to balance, leap, or prevent falls at great heights.

Heartskavo.name: Networked Metabolism
Heartskavo.description: Eating a properly prepared meal clears a mark on any one of your traits and heals a box on any one of your injuries. You are immune to the effects of drifting spores.

Heartskavo.name: Revenant Step
Heartskavo.description: Something about the way you move strikes fear into animal and arthropod alike. You cut when attempting most precise movements, but ignore all cut when attempting to avoid damage from beasts and insect- based hazards.

Heartskavo.name: Noctovore
Heartskavo.description: Heal a mark of damage on any one of your traits after spending a scene in extreme damp or darkness.

Heartskavo.name: Cordevenant
Heartskavo.description: Use a task to breathe new life into any once-living specimen, giving it the Fungal tag.

Heartskavo.name: Myconic Crown
Heartskavo.description: Mark to speed and control the growth of any non-sapient fungus, spore, or mushroom.

Heartskavo.name: Fungal Filaments
Heartskavo.description: You can see perfectly in darkness or dim light, and in utter darkness you increase impact on any actions taken to discern the properties of your surroundings.

Heartskavo.name: From Depth to Depth
Heartskavo.description: Clear a point of mire whenever the Pressure Level increases, or turn a burn on one of your tracks into a normal mark.

Heartskavo.name: Unnerving Fronds
Heartskavo.description: Treat conflicts as triumphs when attempting to scare or unsettle a target. Any ship you crew resists insect incursions.

Heartskavo.name: Sporeburst
Heartskavo.description: Mark to release a cloud of stinging spores, dealing CQ Toxin damage to all nearby foes and coating them with a layer of fast-growing mushrooms.

Heartskavo.name: Slow Surrender
Heartskavo.description: Burn to immediately and completely heal an injury by replacing the affected area with a fungal proxy.

Heartskavo.name: Haskavic Dreamer
Heartskavo.description: Sleeping allows you to dream fragments of other pertinent heartskavo lives, no matter how distant. Spending a night at rest during a journey rewards you with an insight into your current situation (supplied by the Firefly).

Heartskavo.name: Toxic Personality
Heartskavo.description: Just being around you raises one's tolerances. Your entire crew is resistant to Toxin damage, and you are immune.

Heartskavo.name: Breath of Eaves
Heartskavo.description: Use a task and mark to banish or redirect a sporewind, or use a task and burn to summon one.

Heartskavo.name: Wheezing Bellows
Heartskavo.description: A musical instrument that most struggle to find even vaguely pleasant when played. Acts as a weapon in a pinch, doing CQ Blunt or Toxin damage... noisily.

Heartskavo.name: Orbishroom
Heartskavo.description: A plump little follower that rolls drunkenly around your heels. Mark to gain a specimen, either Virulent Spores or Fungal Sheddings.

Stowaway.name: Old Habits Die Hard
Stowaway.description: You can tell what's in a cargo crate before it's even opened. Whenever you drop anchor, gain a resource related to one of the pieces of cargo on your ship.

Stowaway.name: Engine's Toll
Stowaway.description: You survived an accident that should probably have killed you, and you did it alone. Gain immunity to one damage type of your choice, and you have resistance to all damage and effects that would result from hazards and malfunctions on your own ship.

Stowaway.name: Struggle Through
Stowaway.description: Whenever you would be affected by crezzerin, bad air, or drifting spores, you may mark mire to ignore the effect.

Stowaway.name: Underdeck Physique
Stowaway.description: When engaged in a chase of some kind, obstacles that would slow you down give you a burst of speed instead. Treat conflicts as triumphs on actions made to escape or outwit pursuers when you're the quarry.

Stowaway.name: Softshoe Reflexes
Stowaway.description: You leave barely any trace (and are almost impossible to track) when aboard ships or in dockyards. Once per scene, if you are discovered in these areas, hijack focus.

Stowaway.name: Whispering Key
Stowaway.description: Consume a whisper to open (or jam) any mundane lock. Consume a chart to discover hidden locations or crawlspaces nearby.

Stowaway.name: Tar-Stained Cloak
Stowaway.description: When in shadows or areas of limited visibility, mark to shift attention from you to a willing crewmate and be momentarily lost or forgotten to foes. You can see perfectly in darkness.

Stowaway.name: Piecemeal Outfit
Stowaway.description: You chop and change your clothing with whatever you find lying around. Increase impact when attempting to go unnoticed, blend in, or look like you belong.

Stowaway.name: Gasping Jar
Stowaway.description: Burn to temporarily silence a single individual in your immediate vicinity (everything from their voice to their footsteps). You can target yourself with this aspect, but cannot target a crewmate unless they're willing.

Stowaway.name: Stolen Revolver
Stowaway.description: Filched from a member of the undercrew. Deals low- impact LR Blast damage against targets that are aware of you, high-impact LR Blast damage if you're hidden.

Stowaway.name: Flashfinger Construct
Stowaway.description: A mobile hand pieced together from old roster sheets, engine bolts and secrecy. Treat disasters as conflicts when pickpocketing, stealing, or using sleight of hand.

Stowaway.name: Accidental Anchor
Stowaway.description: The spirit of a crewmember lost to the waves has tenuously attached itself to you, unseen and unheard by the rest of the world. Mark mire to gain a secret about the ship, or a location the ship has visited before, or burn mire to make your companion tangible for a brief time.

Stowaway.name: Leashless Monkey
Stowaway.description: Consume a specimen to create a monkey-based distraction in a nearby location. Once per scene, this distraction allows you to hijack focus.

Stowaway.name: Librico Silverfish
Stowaway.description: Mark to gain information about a nearby room or secret space. Consume a chart to have the silverfish, rather disgustingly, create an entirely new chart based on the information discovered, or fragments of overheard speech.

Submerged.name: Marked by the Sea
Submerged.description: The serendipitous swell and shift of seeded surf has served you too many times to be coincidental.

Submerged.name: Sealegs
Submerged.description: Your body was made for moving with the tides. Treat conflicts as triumphs when traversing the open waves without a ship.

Submerged.name: Howl of the Veil
Submerged.description: The echo of this terrible call in your mind dulls natural fear responses. Seeing leviathans and other bestial horrors offers whispers instead of mire.

Submerged.name: Masktopus Tattoo
Submerged.description: A spirit of ink. Mark to slip into the spectral realm for a short time, disappearing entirely from the mundane.

Submerged.name: Prey Instinct
Submerged.description: Knowing how mice think lets you find cats. You always know if you’re being followed, tracked, or stalked.

Submerged.name: Decoy Tactics
Submerged.description: Becoming bait for your pack requires courage, honour, duty, or some other foolishness. Once per scene you may hijack focus to react to an incoming threat in place of another crewmate. That crewmate increases impact on their next action taken against that threat.

Submerged.name: Pheromonal Nose
Submerged.description: You can smell your surroundings as clearly as others see theirs.

Submerged.name: Natural Learner
Submerged.description: After overcoming a nature result during a journey, gain two temporay ranks in any skill related to the experience. These ranks last until the journey ends.

Submerged.name: Adaptive Anatomy
Submerged.description: The changes you've embraced have furnished your body with a natural weapon. You can deal either CQ Keen, Toxin, Blunt, Acid, Volt, or Spike damage (chosen when you take this aspect).

Submerged.name: Leviathan Ambergris
Submerged.description: You have a small sample of leviathan musk, but the effect is potent - you never smell like prey.

Submerged.name: Yelnstra’s Fables
Submerged.description: A loosely bound collection of Yelnstra’s stories gathered and shared by your culture. Mark to receive a useful fable (supplied by the Firefly).

Submerged.name: “A Whispered Roar”
Submerged.description: This named bone instrument contains a whisper gone feral. Consume a whisper to exactly mimic the sound (and volume) of a beast.

Submerged.name: Trophied Longclaw
Submerged.description: Taken in victory under the waves. Deals CQ or LR Hewing or Serrated damage.

Submerged.name: Rode's Path
Submerged.description: Unanchored spirits find you, or at least one has, to serve as point of connection until they find their lasting anchor or decide to sail past the veil. You may mark mire to learn a secret they can share from their restless past life.

Windward.name: Indomitable
Windward.description: You move with purpose, untouched by indecision in the face of certain doom. When you would be forced to cut two or more results, cut one result fewer than usual.

Windward.name: From The Jaws of Defeat
Windward.description: Burn to increase your impact on any action taken in a desperate situation. You can also burn to treat a disaster as a triumph, but only whilst facing a seemingly overwhelming challenge.

Windward.name: Scar of Steps Taken
Windward.description: During a journey, you can make a discovery without consuming a chart. Instead, choose and consume a whisper as normal and then combine it with either one of your mires, an injury you've suffered, or a project you've worked on. The discovery will be tied to your choice.

Windward.name: The Weight of Experience
Windward.description: Whenever you would clear mire you can choose to heal two marks of damage instead. Mark to ignore an instance of mire generated by your own curiosity or actions.

Windward.name: Ascetic's Waltz
Windward.description: Somewhere between a dance, a martial art and an expression of arrogance. Deals CQ Blunt damage and, once per scene, allows you to hijack an incoming attack and choose a new target for it.

Windward.name: You Make Your Own Path
Windward.description: Whenever you would receive a chart, you may convert it to a piece of salvage and a whisper instead. Once per scene, treat a conflict as a triumph when rolling without the benefit of a skill.

Windward.name: Spiced Wine
Windward.description: For warming the spirit and mind on a long, cold night. When you gain a temporary trait, add one box more than usual. Once per montage, without using a task, you may add one box to any one crewmate's temporary trait.

Windward.name: Wayfarer’s Compass
Windward.description: Once per journey, you may tie a new discovery to one of your drives. The precise nature of the connection is up to the Firefly.

Windward.name: Whirl-Crafted Rabir
Windward.description: The calming drone of the rabir allows you to meditate rather than sleep, maintaining full awareness of your surroundings. In addition, when you set the instrument spinning, choose either bad air, drifting spores, insect incursions, or wandering spirits. Your vessel resists this threat until the rabir ceases to spin.

Windward.name: Quartered Raiment
Windward.description: You have resistance to Toxin and Salt damage, and to any damage taken while aiding a crewmate in an action they're attempting.

Windward.name: Oft-Repaired Blade
Windward.description: Deals CQ Keen or Spike damage, but you treat triumphs as conflicts when attacking with this weapon.

Windward.name: Nomad’s Stilt
Windward.description: A long spear-like weapon used to balance on in dangerous areas. Deals CQ Hewing damage, and lets you resist the hazardous effects of crezzerin exposure.

Windward.name: Crumpled Frog
Windward.description: A minuscule wax-paper construct made from an ancient chart. Whenever your crew discovers a new location, the frog will spill a single cryptic secret about it (supplied by the Firefly).

Windward.name: Feathered Cobra
Windward.description: A gliding snake with a generous plumage, aerodynamic feathers spreading out from its curving hood. Deals LR Toxin damage, and you may consume a specimen to gain the Rush and Flap styles until end of scene.

Augur.name: A Reading of Passage
Augur.description: When you have the chance to read the stars while journeying, you may consume a whisper to predict a future encounter. You gain a 1d6 advantage on any interactions with the subject of the prediction.

Augur.name: Flash of Insight
Augur.description: In moments of crisis, you see what happens a fraction of a second before it takes place. Mark mire to ignore the results of a roll. Take a new approach and re-roll.

Augur.name: Skybridge Pirouette
Augur.description: Adapted from a well-known shankling tradition, your feet can find brief purchase on empty air. You gain the Float and Hover styles, but only in short bursts.

Augur.name: Collapsible Recliner
Augur.description: A portable chair offering extreme comfort and an excellent viewing angle. Also deals CQ Blunt damage!

Augur.name: Light-Catch Lantern
Augur.description: A hooded lantern that both emits and consumes light. When lit it acts as you would expect, but when unlit it absorbs the light from a single nearby source.

Augur.name: Somatic Drill
Augur.description: An augur's auger. Deals CQ Spike damage, and allows you to consume a whisper to have a prophetic (but cryptic) dream, details of which are supplied by the Firefly.

Augur.name: Mythologue Fireflies
Augur.description: Fireflies which trace the paths of constellations. Useful for navigation, and pathfinding in dark places.

Augur.name: Wandering Starling
Augur.description: A bird with plumage that gleams like a falling star. When you make a discovery, you uncover two nearby locations which share thematic elements.

Augur.name: Whisperwisp
Augur.description: A spectral creature which enjoys sitting on shoulders and whispering stories in people’s ears. Mark to learn a distant truth (supplied by the Firefly).

Augur.name: Astral Nail Set
Augur.description: Nails forged from fallen stars, waiting to manifest their hidden stories. Deals LR Spike damage. When you choose the Astral Nail Set as an aspect, it gains two benefits of your choice from the following list. You can mark the nail set to use one of your chosen benefits, or burn it to use any of the benefits listed below... Twin Nails : Link the fates of two similar creatures. What happens to one happens to the other. Slink-Nail : Link the senses of a crewmate and a nearby creature. The crewmate can perceive everything the creature does. Solpod Nail : Pierce a plant with this nail to make it grow at a greatly advanced rate. Somnolent Nail : A creature pierced with this nail falls into deep slumber. Plummeting Nail : Use this story to call a comet to the sky, and briefly weaken the veil of the spectral realm. Long-Shadow Nail : Use this story to temporarily pin something by its shadow. Allows the set to deal LR Salt damage for the duration of a scene once used.

Augur.name: Augur's Eyepiece
Augur.description: A ratcheting monocle spilling over with gears and moving parts. Designed to hold several lenses, each one with different properties. When you choose this aspect, it gains two benefits of your choice from the following list... Feathered Lens : Gain a distant bird’s-eye view of your current location. Rainbow Quartz Lens : Allows the viewer to peer into the spectral realm. Cracked Lens : Look around corners and through small gaps. Sapphirine Lens : See the sky above you, regardless of what’s in the way. Warped Lens : See through illusions and deception. Vexing Lens : Gain a third-person view of yourself.

Cannoneer.name: Pure Muscle
Cannoneer.description: You don't get to lug this kind of gear around without developing the muscle to go with it. Mire, Pressure, and Scrutiny effects can never cause you to cut when attempting strength or brawn-based actions.

Cannoneer.name: Battering Ram
Cannoneer.description: Though not famed for your melee prowess, there's a lot to be said for precise applications of weight. Increase impact on CQ attacks when you have a running start.

Cannoneer.name: How It's Done
Cannoneer.description: After dealing massive damage to a target, the next crewmate that attacks that target gains increased impact on their action.

Cannoneer.name: Needle-Point
Cannoneer.description: You may fire LR weapons at extreme distances that wouldn't normally be possible without cutting for difficulty. In addition, you never cut for precision or accuracy when targeting larger opponents or structures.

Cannoneer.name: Me First!
Cannoneer.description: Mark to hijack focus from a leviathan as it attacks your ship or a member of your crew (once per scene). Burn instead of marking to ignore the 'once per scene' limitation of this aspect for that hijacking.

Cannoneer.name: Leaving a Mark
Cannoneer.description: Mark mire to gain a whisper based on damage or an injury you’ve just dealt, supplied by the Firefly.

Cannoneer.name: Oft-Rattled Braincase
Cannoneer.description: When you roll a twist as part of an action that deals massive damage, you may choose to heal a mark of mire or clear a mark on any of your traits in addition to the usual effect.

Cannoneer.name: Full Reef-Iron Plating
Cannoneer.description: Whenever you would take massive damage from an attack of some kind aimed against you, you may burn a box on this gear's track to ignore it.

Cannoneer.name: Salvaged Cannon
Cannoneer.description: What was once a deck-mounted weapon now sits in your hands, absent a ship yet retaining terrifying potency. Cannons deal high-impact LR Blast damage as standard. When you choose the Salvaged Cannon as an aspect, it gains a base frame from the following list... Hullbreaker : Increase your cannon's impact when targeting ships and structures. Mazengara : Increase your cannon's impact when targeting leviathans and protoleviathans. Scattering Storm : Your cannon shots affect multiple nearby targets. A sketchy alteration from the following list... Hazardcrank: Mark while attacking to increase the cannon's impact against any target. Adaptive Loader: Consume a resource to temporarily change the cannon's damage type (with the new type tied to the resource consumed) until end of scene. Explosive Exhaust: The cannon's exhaust ports can be used to increase the impact of leaps and dashes. And a serious flaw from the following list... Dead Weight: You take a cut on all actions made to jump, climb, or move at speed. Ammunition Jam: A disaster while firing jams the weapon until end of scene, making LR attacks impossible. Burn to unjam the cannon early. Wild Thunder : You can't use whispers in any way until end of scene after firing the cannon. Barrel-Parasite : Consume a piece of salvage at the end of any scene in which the cannon is fired. If you don't have salvage to consume, burn a box.

Cannoneer.name: Loading Assistant
Cannoneer.description: A lemur trained to crank handles and ready ammunition. Burn when firing a weapon that deals-high impact or massive damage to immediately fire a second shot using the same roll result.

Diver.name: Cathedral Lungs
Diver.description: You're immune to the effects of bad air, and your voice can carry far farther than usual. You will always be heard, and can 'see' via echolocation even in complete darkness.

Diver.name: Paths in the Dark
Diver.description: When one of your crew uses a chart to help traverse the tangle (or any deeper area) during a journey, add an extra die to each watch roll and take the result you prefer.

Diver.name: Dancing on the Edge
Diver.description: When operating under Pressure, treat disasters as conflicts while moving through the waves.

Diver.name: Ragged Dive-Clothes
Diver.description: You're resistant to the hazardous effects of crezzerin exposure. Mark to become immune to crezzerin for the duration of a scene.

Diver.name: Deeps-Badger Claws
Diver.description: Used by their original owners to carve out places of safety amongst the lower regions of the waves. Deals CQ Keen damage, and you can use a task to lower the effective Pressure Level of your immediate surroundings by one.

Diver.name: Serrospear
Diver.description: A rotating blade lubricated with sizzling chemicals, safely removed from the wielder by a lengthy haft. Deals CQ Serrated or Acid damage, and increases impact on cutting through branches and vines.

Diver.name: Winch-Rifle
Diver.description: A more powerful and direct form of the usual grappling hook. Deals LR Spike damage, and the tethered projectiles can be used to aid in climbing or swinging after being successfully anchored.

Diver.name: Chakio
Diver.description: A weasel-like mammal bred to find handholds and safe routes. When you would cut for manoeuvring under the effects of Pressure, ignore it and increase impact instead.

Diver.name: Pressure Suit
Diver.description: A clanking pressure suit designed to allow its user to explore the depths. When you choose the Pressure Suit as an aspect, it gains two benefits of your choice from the following list... Reinforced Lifelink : A tube snaking back to your ship. You're immune to the effects of bad air, and can act as if you have the Glide style for short distances at depth by swinging from the tubing. Leaf-Rubber Seals : Laced and caulked. You're immune to the effects of insect incursions, and invisible to threats that track by scent or pheromones. Extraction Bellows : Wheezing and perpetually almost clogged. You're immune to the effects of drifting spores. After a scene taken under Pressure, gain a gaseous or spore-based specimen resource. Saltwater Piping : Rarely chosen by anchored or ketra divers. You're immune to the effects of wandering spirits. Your suit also keeps you at a safe temperature no matter the surrounding heat or cold. Amberglass Visor : Flanked by firefly spotlights. You can see almost perfectly in utter darkness, and can shine bright light in a narrow beam ahead of you that cuts through spores, murk, and mists. Caterpillar Chains : Sometimes slow surety is best. Reduce cut by one for you and your crewmates on all movement through the sink or drown. Counterframe : Built to withstand the crush and the surge. You have resistance to the effects of crezzerin, and to Pressure-based damage and effects. And one drawback ... Coiled Tubing : You're weak to both Spike damage and Keen damage. Rusting Joints : Cut when attempting movement- based actions requiring speed or stealth. Limited Air : Mark at the end of every scene you spend at depth without direct access to your own ship, a lowport, or a source of clean surface-grade air.

Kitesailor.name: Kitesail
Kitesailor.description: A folding kite designed to allow its user to explore the skies. You gain the Rush and Glide styles. When you choose the Kitesail as an aspect, it also gains two benefits of your choice from the following list... Drake : Increase impact and ignore cut on aerial stunts performed in thermals and updraughts. Raptor : Increase impact and ignore cut on aerial stunts performed favourable winds. Chemjet : Consume a source of fuel to gain the Soar style for a short time. Hinge Array : Gain the Flap style. Thundering : Treat storms and electrical disturbances as a positive condition. Your kitesail can deal CQ Volt damage. Stunt Kite : Treat conflicts as triumphs when performing aerial stunts. Combat Kite : Your kitesail can deal both Blunt and Keen damage. Cometmoth : Your flight and gliding are both far faster than usual. Feathered : You're weak to Flame, but treat conflicts as triumphs when hunting while airborne or diving in for an aggressive action. Sturdy : Add one box to the kitesail's track.

Kitesailor.name: Born for the Skies
Kitesailor.description: If you would cut on a roll made to manoeuvre or fight due to the Scrutiny track, ignore it and increase the impact of your action instead.

Kitesailor.name: Emergency Repairs
Kitesailor.description: Hijack and consume a piece of appropriate salvage to remove a mark from one of your gear aspects instantly, no more than once per scene.

Kitesailor.name: Snapdragon's Fervour
Kitesailor.description: Add a beneficial tag to any resources you acquire while flying or falling.

Kitesailor.name: The Seventh Sense
Kitesailor.description: You are attuned to the winds, and can see updraughts and gusts moments before they occur. Use a task to deepen your connection to the atmosphere, learning about future changes in weather or temperature.

Kitesailor.name: Wingtip Swing
Kitesailor.description: A fighting style designed for aerial combat. Deals CQ Keen damage, and lets you treat conflicts as triumphs when rolling to engage an opponent while airborne.

Kitesailor.name: Flight Visor
Kitesailor.description: You can see clearly through rain, storms, and clouds, and can see detail at a far greater distance than usual.

Kitesailor.name: Buoyloon
Kitesailor.description: A chemical compression chamber and attached gasbag that can send you rocketing skyward. Burn to gain the Float and Hover styles, and immediately ascend at a rapid pace if you wish.

Kitesailor.name: Scatterbombs
Kitesailor.description: Deal LR Blast or Frost damage, and can hit multiple nearby targets when used from an elevated position.

Kitesailor.name: Livesail
Kitesailor.description: A biological companion that tolerates being used as a kitesail. Consume a specimen to gain the Rush and Soar styles until end of scene.

Kitesailor.name: Gull of Hearts
Kitesailor.description: Brave but fragile, a reliable aerial companion. Clear a mark or burn from one of the watchul eyes whenever you sight a wonder or horror while airborne.

Marketeer.name: Aureate Kiss
Marketeer.description: Some say it’s a curse, you say the only thing better than a silver tongue is a golden one. Your bites deal CQ Salt damage. You can also use a task to swallow a resource and recover it with the Golden tag, but imbibing food and drink always inflicts mire.

Marketeer.name: Oligarch
Marketeer.description: You’re regarded with awe by merchants and artisans of all sorts. You ask for and receive no discounts, and they withhold no wares or information from you - you never cut when attempting to deal or bargain.

Marketeer.name: Supplying Demand
Marketeer.description: You can create a need where there was none before. Mark to make a mundane object intriguing and desirable for the scene. Burn to turn the object into an obsession.

Marketeer.name: Odds Broker
Marketeer.description: Fate is a gambler, and you know how to place bets in her game. Once per scene you can call the result of a roll before it’s made (either triumph, conflict, or disaster). If you call it correctly, gain a relevant resource.

Marketeer.name: Loan Wolf
Marketeer.description: You have a fearsome reputation for collecting on debts owed to you. Repayments and rewards always come with interest (such as a resource or favor).

Marketeer.name: Lingua Fortunae
Marketeer.description: Fluency and cultural understanding can mean the difference between trading for a jagserry and trading for a stag berry. Treat conflicts as triumphs whenever you acquire a resource using a language other than Low Sour.

Marketeer.name: Record of Accounting
Marketeer.description: Your list of receipts and lines of credit fill multiple volumes, allowing you to collect dividends almost anywhere. Whenever you dock at port, gain either two common local resources, or a single rare local resource.

Marketeer.name: Tariffigy
Marketeer.description: A spirit of greed anchored to a personal object that protects you—for a price. Consume a resource to gain resistance to any instance of damage. If the resource has a valuable tag (such as Heirloom ), gain immunity instead.

Marketeer.name: Protectionism Plan
Marketeer.description: A strict budget scrawled across a ledger in crimson, proving that resourcefulness and austerity can sometimes be painful. Once per scene you may mark one of your aspects, or your crewmates’ with their permission, to acquire a resource related to that aspect.

Marketeer.name: Pidgin Eggs
Marketeer.description: An ample supply of protein gathered from fowl mimics. Use a task to eat one, gaining two temporary ranks in a language of your choice until you use this aspect again.

Marketeer.name: Hazardous Goods
Marketeer.description: It's the merchant of death that chooses who suffers, and how. You can deal two types of LR damage from the following list: Blunt, Spike, Blast, Toxin, or Salt. Mark this gear in port to acquire a dangerous resource.

Marketeer.name: Warebear
Marketeer.description: An entrepreneurial raccoon-dog, exiled by its pack for gathering greenery rather than food. Consume any two resources to gain a leaf-based specimen with the Medicinal , Spectral , Poisonous , or Mesmeric tag.

Marketeer.name: Trade Winds
Marketeer.description: A spirited zephyr at your back that delights in deals. Consume a resource to increase impact on movement related actions for the duration of a scene. Increase your ship’s speed rating by 1 while it has cargo aboard.

Marketeer.name: Viridian Viper
Marketeer.description: A wily serpent that’s as cunning as you are. Deals CQ Toxin damage. Mark to gain a specimen, Snake-Oil.

Pilot.name: Home Deck Advantage
Pilot.description: You increase impact on all actions taken to fight and defend against foes that have boarded your ship.

Pilot.name: Hold On To Your Hats
Pilot.description: You may mark this aspect while near or at the helm of a ship to perform a difficult manoeuvre or aerial stunt unerringly, without making a ratings roll. Burning this aspect allows you to hijack focus for this action.

Pilot.name: Air of Competency
Pilot.description: When you take this trait, choose two ratings from the following six: Armour, Seals, Speed, Saws, Stealth, and Tilt. Increase both of these ratings by one while you're aboard your own ship.

Pilot.name: The Other Left
Pilot.description: Mark to allow you, or a crewmate, to treat a disaster on a ratings roll as a conflict instead.

Pilot.name: Situational Awareness
Pilot.description: A mixture of gut feeling and pattern recognition tells you more than most when approaching the unknown. The Firefly makes threat rolls out in the open when determining the level of danger during a journey.

Pilot.name: Creakophony
Pilot.description: You are immediately aware of any Pressure-based invasion of your ship (from spores and spirits to bad air and insects), and your ship also has two additional boxes on any Pressure track as long as you're aboard.

Pilot.name: Hullcradle
Pilot.description: A true nautical soul. You're weak to Salt, but can take the helm and steer the ship from any part of your vessel, even belowdecks. Your ship is also immune to wandering spirits, and invisible to spirit-based watchful eyes.

Pilot.name: Familiar Routes
Pilot.description: Whenever you or an ally would consume a chart, make a 1d6 fortune roll. On a 6, that chart is not consumed and instead gains the Familiar tag.

Pilot.name: Copper-Knot Scarf
Pilot.description: Threaded with a filigree of engine wiring. Deals CQ Volt damage, and you're resistant to Volt damage yourself. When under Pressure, you're also resistant to the harmful effects of crezzerin.

Pilot.name: Nautic Cowl & Goggles
Pilot.description: Traditional dress for pilots expecting hostile skies. You can see through mists, clouds, and sporeclouds clearly, and you're resistant to damage and effects caused by poor atmospheric and environmental conditions.

Pilot.name: Eye-Scraper Jerky
Pilot.description: Laced with mild psychoactive chemicals to heighten alertness. Mark to gain a burst of detailed information about something in the distance (supplied by the Firefly), and you never need to rest or sleep on journeys.

Pilot.name: Unwrecker's Wrench
Pilot.description: Deals CQ Blunt damage. Whenever your ship would suffer structural damage, reduce the number of boxes on the damage track by two.

Pilot.name: Hushed Parakeet
Pilot.description: You may mark this companion to remove a single cut result from any roll that would be affected by Scrutiny.

Pilot.name: Ratwork Refugees
Pilot.description: Saved from a broken cluster and trained to help more than they hinder. Consume a specimen to reduce one of your ship's ratings by one and boost another by two. This change lasts until you consume another specimen in this way, or until the end of a journey.

Rattlewing.name: Aviotinker
Rattlewing.description: Use a task to add a takeoff or flight style of your choice to any aspect, belonging to you or a companion, that already has a style of some kind. This addition lasts until replaced by another using Aviotinker, but a character can only benefit from one of these additions at a time.

Rattlewing.name: On Awkward Wings
Rattlewing.description: On completion of a creation, you may consume an additional piece of salvage to add the Rush and Flap styles to it in addition to any existing benefits, and reduce the length of the creation's track by one box.

Rattlewing.name: Emergency Innovation
Rattlewing.description: You can craft using only one resource (rather than the usual minimum of two) when under Pressure, or when at least one watchful eye is marked.

Rattlewing.name: More Than Maintenance
Rattlewing.description: No ship of yours is safe from continual improvement. Choose a takeoff or flight style from the following list: Rush, Float, Hover, Glide, Flap, or Soar. Any ship you crew that already has lift systems gains this chosen style in addition to any existing styles.

Rattlewing.name: The Purr and the Claw
Rattlewing.description: Any ship you crew ignores the usual damage dealt by a lift system's takeoff cost in all but the most terrible atmospheric or environmental conditions.

Rattlewing.name: Enlightening Chaff
Rattlewing.description: Mark to make thermals, air currents, and magnetic forces in your area visible for a short time. You and your companions treat disasters as conflicts when using these to aid with flight-related rolls.

Rattlewing.name: Deadening Bolt
Rattlewing.description: Mark to render flight, by any means, impossible in your vicinity for a short time. Burn to do the same, but excluding you and your companions from the effect.

Rattlewing.name: Portable Chemicovent
Rattlewing.description: You gain Frost resistance, and both you and any nearby allies reduce the negative effects of windchill and extreme cold. You may also mark to create a temporary updraught around and above you.

Rattlewing.name: Skimmers
Rattlewing.description: For some it's the thrill of speed that draws them to invention, whether airborne or not. Increase impact on actions taken to sprint, slide, or chase, and you gain the Rush takeoff style (but no additional flight style).

Rattlewing.name: Reef-Iron Pinions
Rattlewing.description: Jagged, noisy, and spectacular. You gain the Rush and Flap styles, and can deal CQ Serrated damage, but cut whenever you attempt stealthy or quiet activities.

Rattlewing.name: Ironroot Repulsors
Rattlewing.description: Useless for the skies, but perfect for the depths. You gain the Float, Hover, and Glide styles while close to an ironroot's trunk or branches.

Rattlewing.name: Vortex Aerofans
Rattlewing.description: A logical next step for the classic rattlehand vortex box. You gain the Float and Hover styles, and can attack with sudden bursts of air dealing LR Blast damage.

Rattlewing.name: Raka-Jets
Rattlewing.description: A tool most often used by airborne pirates to launch surprise attacks, these wrist- or ankle-mounted jets allow you to mark them for either a burst of extreme aerial speed or a jet-accelerated CQ strike, dealing increased impact with one of your existing damage types.

Rattlewing.name: Mobile Scrapbox
Rattlewing.description: A hovering iron chest that follows you closely, occasionally knocking into your ankles. Use a task to make a 1d6 fortune roll. On a 1, 2, or 3, you gain no benefit. On a 4 or 5, you gain one piece of salvage. On a 6, you gain two pieces of salvage. The resources you gain are provided by the Firefly.

Raveller.name: Off the Cuff
Raveller.description: Whatever clothing you wear ripples with inner life, sometimes even acting on its own accord... Not always in the most helpful ways, though. Treat your clothes as an extra limb, capable of manipulating additional objects.

Raveller.name: To Shreds
Raveller.description: You see the threads that bind reality to whatever lies beyond the veil. Mark mire to slice or tear a usually resilient material as if it were cheap cloth.

Raveller.name: The Threads That Bind
Raveller.description: The ragged edges of your clothing unravel into fluttering tendrils of cloth. Treat conflicts as triumphs when climbing or brachiating, and increase impact when attempting to tangle, trip or ensnare a nearby foe.

Raveller.name: Anchoring Thimble
Raveller.description: You can use a task to tie a spirit to one of your resources, consuming the resource and anchoring the spirit.

Raveller.name: Chiraloth
Raveller.description: Mark to have clothes restitch themselves to mimic a uniform or piece of unique attire from a wildsea group or faction. Burn for a perfect, precise visual recreation.

Raveller.name: The Loom
Raveller.description: A large contraption of needles, pattern-cards, and rolling drums. Treat disasters as conflicts when crafting or repairing anything with a fabric-based resource.

Raveller.name: Grappling Needle
Raveller.description: An oversized needle and thread, used to aid with swinging and climbing. Deals LR Spike damage.

Raveller.name: Plush Pal
Raveller.description: With rough-cut stuffing, buttons for eyes and a fledgling soul, the plush pal is an effective and adorable friend.

Raveller.name: Porcuquill
Raveller.description: A spiny little critter nestled among your clothes. Mark to produce a rare resource, Perfect Needle.

Raveller.name: Ravelliko
Raveller.description: A writhing bundle of living fabric that wears you as much as you wear it. When you choose the Ravelliko as an aspect, it gains two benefits of your choice from the following list... Words in Thread : The Ravelliko can rapidly stitch elegant writing across itself to communicate directly (in any language you speak). Crawlscarf : The Ravelliko holds you just above the ground, moving you around with a silent, silken step. Unpick : Use a task to gain a resource, Fine Thread or Coarse Fabric . Spirit of Silk : Deals Salt damage at CQ or LR. Sewed Edging : Deals Keen damage at CQ or LR. Living Dye : The Ravelliko's colours swirl in vibrant, mesmeric, or camouflaging patterns. Catchsail : Your Ravelliko can catch the winds - mark to gain the Rush and Glide styles until end of scene.

Raveller.name: Memorial Fur
Raveller.description: A stark reminder of death and beauty, a fur taken from a once-great beast that now blankets and protects you. When you choose the Memorial Fur as an aspect, it gains two benefits of your choice from the following list... Leftover Eyes : You have 360 degree vision, and reduce the impact of any effect that makes it more difficult for you to see. Feral Memory : Mark to gain two temporary ranks in a skill related to the animal your fur was taken from. These ranks last until end of scene. Leathern : You're resistant to Keen and Frost damage. Jaws & Claws : Deals CQ Spike or Serrated damage (choose when you gain this aspect). Sinewed : Treat conflicts as triumphs when leaping. The Beast Without : When you mark the last box on this aspect's track, instantly hijack focus. An attack made with this focus has increased impact.

Smuggler.name: Silverleaf Tongue
Smuggler.description: Treat disasters as conflicts when conversing or outwitting pirates, auditors, and other smugglers.

Smuggler.name: Easy Come, Easy Go
Smuggler.description: Using your resources as makeshift weapons in combat doesn't risk damaging or destroying them (though some actions might involve you having to pick them up again).

Smuggler.name: Know How to Pack It
Smuggler.description: Damage to your ship never damages the cargo within it. Your cargo space (and cargo space only) is additionally resistant to insect incursions and drifting spores.

Smuggler.name: Winning Smile
Smuggler.description: Even those that despise you know you sometimes keep your word. Consume a whisper to earn a modicum of trust where it shouldn't be, albeit temporarily.

Smuggler.name: Wrapped in Rippling Words
Smuggler.description: Sometimes it's better to confuse. Consume a whisper to briefly disguise your face, voice, and clothes, becoming a chameleonesque ripple to eyes and memory.

Smuggler.name: Balancing Act
Smuggler.description: Salvage never seems to weigh you down. When you take damage to an aspect, you can reduce the number of marks by one by adding a negative tag to one of your resources (if the resource already has a negative tag, destroy it instead).

Smuggler.name: Fleet-Heel
Smuggler.description: Once per scene, when the final box is marked on a secret or hidden track, hijack focus to act in the last moment possible before the change it brings.

Smuggler.name: Wickless Lantern
Smuggler.description: The amber eyepiece accompanying this lantern allows you to see by the light it remembers shedding. You can see perfectly in darkness, and increase impact when sneaking or staying hidden in dim areas.

Smuggler.name: Commanding Tricorn
Smuggler.description: Ignore mire caused by your own crewmates or undercrew, and reduce the impact of Pressure effects that would affect the undercrew.

Smuggler.name: Disarming Cutlass
Smuggler.description: Deals CQ Keen damage, and increase impact when attempting to disarm a foe.

Smuggler.name: Axehead Blunderbuss
Smuggler.description: Deals CQ Blunt or Hewing damage to multiple nearby targets at once.

Smuggler.name: Chemical Flashbangs
Smuggler.description: Deal LR Blast damage, or mark to produce a blinding flash that affects multiple targets.

Smuggler.name: Multi-Hued Moths
Smuggler.description: Used to send and interpret messages in signalling at extreme range - the moths are trained to send their messages directionally, and such messages are almost invisible to anyone other than the target.

Smuggler.name: Crafty Lemurs
Smuggler.description: Once per montage, identify the location of a nearby piece of valuable material that can be taken as cargo (details supplied by the Firefly).

Smuggler.name: Smuggle Bug
Smuggler.description: A large beetle that can store things in its stomach, safe from digestion and prying eyes.

Smuggler.name: A Fragment of an Old Friend
Smuggler.description: Anchored to something small but valuable on your person, this spirit fades restlessly in and out of existence. Never cut when handling dangerous cargo, and you have resistance to all damage dealt by such items.

Swarmjack.name: Honey For Blood
Swarmjack.description: ... Or, if you have no blood, some other kind of useful liquid. Use a task to gain a rare resource, either Warm Honey , Cicatrix Wax , or Artery Grub .

Swarmjack.name: Spread the Swarm
Swarmjack.description: Burn to scatter your charges in all directions, finding any secret crevices and hidden things nearby (and doubtless causing chaos while doing it).

Swarmjack.name: The Hive Remembers
Swarmjack.description: Whenever you would use a chart, mark to instead rely on scraps of knowledge from your insect attendants.

Swarmjack.name: Coruscating Shield
Swarmjack.description: A glittering, scuttling sacrifice. When you or a nearby ally would take more than one mark of damage, reduce that damage to a single mark on this aspect and ignore any additional effects it would cause (once per scene).

Swarmjack.name: To The Bone
Swarmjack.description: Use a task to direct your swarm to consume a fallen foe. When this task is completed, gain one of all possible non-edible resources that looting or butchering the foe might have offered (for example, bones and metals would be left behind, but meats and fruits would not).

Swarmjack.name: Royal-Jack Array
Swarmjack.description: A curious mechanism worn around the throat. Consume a whisper to translate speech in any language to chemical bursts, understandable by most insects.

Swarmjack.name: Pheromone Bellows
Swarmjack.description: Pump hard for maximum effect. Burn to thoroughly confuse a swarm, or drive them into an intense instinctual behaviour (such as fear, hunger, or frenzy).

Swarmjack.name: Tome of Scuttling Pages
Swarmjack.description: A repository of arthropod information. When you enter a new port or area of the sea, define a single useful insect common to the area and immediately gain one as a specimen (either living or dead).

Swarmjack.name: Colony Backpack
Swarmjack.description: Never quite at rest, but their work is impossible to direct. Whenever an ally gains a specimen or piece of salvage, make a fortune roll using a d6. On a 6, you gain a copy of this resource with the Waxen tag.

Swarmjack.name: Signal Spikes
Swarmjack.description: Clusters of chemical-drenched burrs that stick to clothes and hair, dealing LR Toxin damage. Once a target has been hit with a signal spike, mark to draw a swarm of stinging insects to them for a brief time, or consume a specimen to discern their exact location.

Swarmjack.name: Herding Bat
Swarmjack.description: Trained to manipulate the movements of swarms via whistled commands. The herding bat allows you to naturally attract, shepherd, or repel swarms of non- aggressive insects.

Swarmjack.name: Dedicated Swarm
Swarmjack.description: Perhaps centipedes, or bees, or scorpions - the crawling, droning creatures that swarm around you, are up to you to define. When you choose Dedicated Swarm as an aspect, it gains two benefits of your choice from the following list... Swarmalanquin : You are carried on a million tiny legs. Increase impact when climbing or scrambling through tight spaces. Countless Wings : Mark to gain the Float and Hover styles for the duration of a scene. Used to It : You're resistant to Toxin damage, and any damage dealt by swarm or insect-based hazards. Releasing the Horde : Deals Spike, Toxin, or Acid damage at CQ or LR (choose the type and range when you gain this benefit). Jealous Charges : Both you and your ship are immune to the effects of insect incursions. Undulating Movement : Ignore cut when attempting to defend against incoming attacks.

Thorn.name: Gnarled Host
Thorn.description: You’re host to a spreading, fibrous infection that hardens your flesh into bark-like plates. You are weak to Flame and either Hewing or Serrated damage, but immune to Blunt and either Keen or Toxin.

Thorn.name: Crezzer-Blooded
Thorn.description: You’re immune to the effects of crezzerin. Use a task to create a resource, Concentrated Crezzerin .

Thorn.name: Nurturing Chant
Thorn.description: Use a task to grow a seed into a small plant, or to coax an already-grown plant into producing flowers or fruit. If this growth affects a Project track mark one more box than usual.

Thorn.name: Bursting Bloom
Thorn.description: A wildflower winding through your limbs, but never tangling them. Mark to create a nearby point of interest by forcing plants into an unexpected burst of growth.

Thorn.name: Grave-Roots
Thorn.description: Burn to root yourself where you stand for a short period of time. When rooted, you are almost entirely immovable (and cannot move yourself without unrooting either), and nearby crewmates benefit from your resistances and immunities.

Thorn.name: Sizzling Sap
Thorn.description: An arconautic organ somewhere in your body allows you to spit searing sap at a distance, allowing you to deal LR Acid or Toxin damage.

Thorn.name: Heirloom Seed-Bottles
Thorn.description: Brimming with potential life. Use a task to create one of the following resources: Thorn Grain , Nascent Wormapple , Beansprouts, or Micromelon.

Thorn.name: Inscribed Root
Thorn.description: Mark to reshape nearby exposed wood into a useful obstacle. Mark mire to reshape nearby exposed wood into a winding path.

Thorn.name: Symbiote Seed-Bed
Thorn.description: Use a task to give an ally a one-box temporary aspect, Symbiote Seed , that grants them resistance to a single damage type of your choice. When that aspect is lost, gain a plant specimen related to their bloodline.

Thorn.name: Gentle Scythe
Thorn.description: Almost definitely a misnomer. Deals CQ Keen or Hewing damage, with increased impact against plant-based foes.

Thorn.name: Autumnal Drift
Thorn.description: Leaves dance around you, holding you aloft. Treat conflicts as triumphs when wavewalking. Mark to gain the Float and Glide styles until end of scene.

Thorn.name: Trained Hummingbird
Thorn.description: Swift and sharp-eyed. Mark to identify a rare or unusual plant-based specimen in your vicinity. Anemone

Thorn.name: Ghast
Thorn.description: A bundle of animated, spine-like tendrils made of rough soil and ragged soul. Allows you to hold or manipulate many objects at once, and can be used to deal CQ Salt damage.

Zealot.name: Hollow Mantra
Zealot.description: Nobody's listening, most likely, but words still hold power. Use a task to give one of your whispers the Echoing or Hungry tag.

Zealot.name: Bellow of the Beast
Zealot.description: When you use a whisper to shout (creating a high-impact change that's out of your control), you are immune to damage or negative effects that result from that change.

Zealot.name: Spiral Scars
Zealot.description: A cause. A purpose. A promise. Once per scene you may ignore an instance of cut that would affect you by marking mire.

Zealot.name: Consecrated Ramblings
Zealot.description: You gain increased impact on rolls made to convince or disorient with words. If you have a fully marked mire, treat conflicts as triumphs when engaged in these actions.

Zealot.name: The Hard Road Back
Zealot.description: Consume a whisper to turn a burn to a mark, or to clear a mark of mire, on any character once per scene.

Zealot.name: Hasty Doomsayer
Zealot.description: Once per scene, you may mark mire to hijack focus. Treat triumphs as conflicts for any action take with this hijacked focus.

Zealot.name: Fallen Pillars
Zealot.description: When you make a discovery, you may combine two whispers rather than a whisper and a chart. Treat disasters as conflicts when rolling to explore or discern the history of locations discovered in this way.

Zealot.name: Rampant Tongue
Zealot.description: You count as having a single rank, a smattering, in all known languages... But only to speak them, not to understand them when you hear or read them.

Zealot.name: Hymn-Scribed Dice
Zealot.description: Whenever you make a fortune roll, or would be directly affected by one, roll an additonal d6 and choose the result you prefer.

Zealot.name: Melismaphone
Zealot.description: A rickety sound-producing device with a scratched wax cylinder spinning within it. Whenever a member of the crew rolls peace while on watch, you and your crewmates can each clear a mark of mire.

Zealot.name: Decorated Leviathan's Tooth
Zealot.description: Once per scene, burn the leviathan's tooth to ignore an instance of incoming damage. For the remainder of the scene, the tooth deals high-impact CQ damage of the type it allowed you to ignore.

Zealot.name: Rope-Strung Tablets
Zealot.description: Promises were made to be broken. Burn to gain a whisper related to either your faith or the current situation.

Zealot.name: Tattered Vestments
Zealot.description: From the following list of damage types, gain one immunity, one resistance and one weakness: Acid, Toxin, Frost, Flame, Volt, or Salt.

Zealot.name: Shrineruff Mastiff
Zealot.description: The shaggy pelt of this hound is shot through with prayer tablets, scraps of hymn-scrawled paper and 'divine' charms. Deals CQ Salt damage, and allows you to mark any of your trait tracks to gain a whisper or chart relevant to your faith.

Zealot.name: Protoleviathan Grubling
Zealot.description: This companion can only be marked by mire. When fully marked, you and your crew are immune to Pressure increases caused by leviathan and protoleviathan signs, effects, or encounters.
